## Tasks

This step exports Supplementary Figures 1 and 2. S1 contains sequence-length/CheckV quality and detection-depth diagnostics, including within-table read-subsampling curves. S2 contains qualified detection patterns, abundance contributions and 83 best-host-genus links co-detected in at least one sample. Counts are descriptive; no model, test or threshold is added. Complete PERMANOVA, dispersion and cross-assay results are retained in Data 1 S10, S11 and S09.

### Task 1: Inputs

```{r}
#| label: inputs
manifest <- rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "010-input-manifest", "input-manifest.tsv"))
style <- rwv_style_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/style.yml", manifest))
style <- rwv_style_for_figure(style, "sfig1")   # v40: figure-specific text sizes (config/style.yml figure_text_pt)
samples <- rwv_samples_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/samples.tsv", manifest), style)
palettes <- rwv_palettes_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/palettes.yml", manifest))
figures <- rwv_figures_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/figures.yml", manifest))
defs <- rwv_definitions_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/definitions.tsv", manifest))
up <- function(f) as.data.frame(rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "020-community-analysis", f)))
catalogue <- up("checkv_catalogue.tsv")
curves <- up("rarefaction_curves.tsv")
depth <- up("depth.tsv")
depth_check <- up("depth_check.tsv")
sharing_patterns <- up("votu_sharing_patterns.tsv")
sharing_samples <- up("votu_sharing_samples.tsv")
sharing_members <- up("votu_sharing_members.tsv")
# Supplementary Figure 2 (2026-10-17): the 200 retained iPHoP best-host records and their per-sample co-detection.
hosts <- up("host_iphop.tsv")
codet <- up("host_codetection_by_sample.tsv")
fonts <- rwv_fonts_resolve(style)
fonts2 <- rwv_fonts_resolve(style, italic = TRUE)   # S2c genus labels are italic
spec <- rwv_figure_spec(figures, "sfig1", params$name)
spec2 <- rwv_figure_spec(figures, "sfig2", params$name)
checks <- rwv_checks_new()
rwv_check(checks, "Supplementary Figures 1 and 2 share one text-size override (v40)", style$figure_text_pt$sfig1, style$figure_text_pt$sfig2, source = "config/style.yml")
checks2 <- rwv_checks_new()
pt <- style$text_pt; ink <- style$colours$text; fam <- style$font$family
lvl <- rwv_sample_levels(samples)
site_of <- setNames(as.character(samples$site), lvl)
omics <- c(virome = "Virome", bact_16s = "16S (prokaryotes)", euk_18s_microeuk = "18S (microeukaryotes)")
```

### Task 2: S1a: representative sequence lengths for all quality categories

```{r}
#| label: panel-a
cls <- names(palettes$checkv)
catalogue$len_kb <- as.numeric(catalogue$contig_length_bp) / 1000
catalogue$checkv_quality <- factor(catalogue$checkv_quality, levels = cls)
n_cls <- as.numeric(table(catalogue$checkv_quality))
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "catalogue_votu", sum(n_cls), "checkv_catalogue.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "five CheckV classes (167/142/450/2254/47)", c(167, 142, 450, 2254, 47), n_cls,
          source = "regression constant; class totals also checked in 110 against definitions.tsv")
lab_n <- data.frame(checkv_quality = factor(cls, levels = cls), n = n_cls,
                    med = tapply(catalogue$len_kb, catalogue$checkv_quality, median))
# Horizontal boxes so the full CheckV class names fit; Complete on top as in Figure 1E.
p_len <- ggplot(catalogue, aes(x = len_kb, y = checkv_quality)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = checkv_quality), width = 0.62, outlier.size = 0.6, outlier.stroke = 0,
               outlier.colour = style$colours$grey_dark, colour = ink, linewidth = rwv_linewidth(style$line_mm$thin),
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = unlist(palettes$checkv)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(cls), labels = function(x) paste0(x,   # v45: CheckV label mapping moved to the legend
                                                                        " (n = ", rwv_fmt_int(n_cls[match(x, cls)]), ")")) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(10, 20, 50, 100, 150), limits = c(9, 200)) +
  labs(tag = rwv_tag(style, "A"), x = "Length (kb, log scale)", y = NULL) +
  rwv_panel(style)
```

### Task 3: S1c: within-table read-subsampling curves

The curves use Hurlbert analytic expectations calculated in 020, interpolated only up to each sample's observed depth. Viral curves show unmasked counts and counts after the fixed full-depth breadth mask; amplicons retain their own processing. Curves characterize detection within the retained feature tables, not assembly/mapping completeness or full environmental community recovery.

```{r}
#| label: panel-c-curves
layer_lab <- c(virome_unmasked = "Virome: all mapped counts", virome_masked = "Virome: breadth-masked counts",   # v45 short titles
               bact_16s = "16S ASVs", euk_18s_microeuk = "18S microeukaryotic ASVs")
layer_unit <- c(virome_unmasked = 1e6, virome_masked = 1e6, bact_16s = 1e3, euk_18s_microeuk = 1e3)
# F6: common_depth is the literal "NA" except at the common-depth points; convert that token explicitly so a
# coercion warning (or the check below) signals only an unexpected value.
curve_bad <- 0
for (k in c("depth_reads", "expected_features", "sample_total_reads", "observed_features", "common_depth")) {
  v <- curves[[k]]; lit <- is.na(v) | v %in% "NA"
  curves[[k]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(replace(v, lit, NA)))
  curve_bad <- curve_bad + sum(!lit & is.na(curves[[k]]))
}
rwv_check(checks, "rarefaction curve columns are numeric or the literal NA", 0, curve_bad, source = "rarefaction_curves.tsv")
curves$is_common_depth <- curves$is_common_depth == "TRUE"
rwv_check(checks, "curve layers and samples (4 layers x 7 samples)", 28L, nrow(unique(curves[, c("layer", "sample_id")])))
endp <- curves[curves$depth_reads == curves$sample_total_reads, ]
rwv_check(checks, "each curve ends at its own observed total (no extrapolation)", 28L, nrow(endp))
rwv_check(checks, "curve end equals the observed feature count", TRUE, isTRUE(all.equal(endp$expected_features, endp$observed_features)))
m_end <- endp[endp$layer == "virome_masked", ]
rwv_check(checks, "masked-virome curve ends equal the masked richness of panel b", as.numeric(depth$masked_richness[match(m_end$sample_id, depth$sample_id)]),
          m_end$observed_features, source = "depth.tsv")
curves$sample_id <- factor(curves$sample_id, levels = lvl)
curves$site <- factor(site_of[as.character(curves$sample_id)], levels = names(rwv_site_colours(style)))
# One small plot per count table, each with its own axis: the two virome tables span
# 0.01-11 million reads and are drawn on a log axis so the early rise of the masked
# curve stays visible; amplicons use a linear axis in thousands of reads.
x_info <- list(
  virome_unmasked = list(unit = 1e6, log = TRUE, lab = "Mapped reads (millions, log scale)"),   # v45: "subsampled" in the legend
  virome_masked = list(unit = 1e6, log = TRUE, lab = "Masked reads (millions, log scale)"),
  bact_16s = list(unit = 1e3, log = FALSE, lab = "16S reads (thousands)"),
  euk_18s_microeuk = list(unit = 1e3, log = FALSE, lab = "Total 18S reads (thousands)"))   # denominator stays all 18S
curve_plot <- function(layer, tag = NULL, y_lab = NULL) {
  d <- curves[curves$layer == layer, ]
  xi <- x_info[[layer]]
  if (xi$log) d <- d[d$depth_reads >= 1e3, ]   # log axis starts at 1,000 reads
  d$x <- d$depth_reads / xi$unit
  ends <- d[d$depth_reads == d$sample_total_reads, ]
  # v44: two label anchors moved to avoid collisions (16S bd1, 18S gc1); curves and end points are unchanged
  ends$label_dy <- 0
  ends$label_dx <- if (xi$log) 0.12 else 0.04 * max(d$x)
  if (layer == "euk_18s_microeuk") {
    ends$label_dy[ends$sample_id == "gc1"] <- -40
    ends$label_dx[ends$sample_id == "gc1"] <- 0.08 * max(d$x)
  }
  if (layer == "bact_16s") {
    ends$label_dy[ends$sample_id == "bd1"] <- -100
    ends$label_dx[ends$sample_id == "bd1"] <- 0.10 * max(d$x)
  }
  cdx <- unique(d$common_depth[!is.na(d$common_depth)]) / xi$unit
  g <- ggplot(d, aes(x = x, y = expected_features, group = sample_id, colour = site)) +
    { if (length(cdx)) geom_vline(xintercept = cdx, colour = style$colours$grey_ref,
                                  linewidth = rwv_linewidth(style$line_mm$thin), linetype = "22") } +
    geom_line(linewidth = rwv_linewidth(style$line_mm$main), show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = ends, size = style$point_mm$feature, show.legend = FALSE) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = ends, aes(label = sample_id), family = fam, size = rwv_text_pt(style, pt$minimum),
                             direction = "y", hjust = 0, nudge_x = ends$label_dx, nudge_y = ends$label_dy, xlim = c(NA, Inf),
                             seed = 3, min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.15, point.padding = 0.1,
                             segment.size = rwv_linewidth(style$line_mm$hairline), segment.colour = style$colours$grey_ref,
                             show.legend = FALSE) +
    rwv_scale_colour_site(style) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06)), labels = rwv_axis_num) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(subtitle = layer_lab[[layer]], x = xi$lab, y = y_lab, tag = tag) +
    rwv_panel(style) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = pt$minimum), axis.title = element_text(size = pt$minimum),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = pt$annotation), plot.margin = margin(1, 9, 1, 1, unit = "mm"))
  if (xi$log) g + scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10), labels = c("0.001", "0.01", "0.1", "1", "10"))
  else g + scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02)), labels = rwv_axis_num)
}
tag_c <- rwv_tag(style, "C")
p_sat <- wrap_elements(full = (curve_plot("virome_unmasked", tag = tag_c, y_lab = "Expected vOTUs") +
                                 curve_plot("virome_masked")) /
                                (curve_plot("bact_16s", y_lab = "Expected ASVs") + curve_plot("euk_18s_microeuk")))
```

### Task 4: S1b: masked richness and mapped viral reads

The saved Spearman rho = 0.857 (n = 7) relates richness to mapped reads, not Shannon. It is not recalculated here.

```{r}
#| label: panel-c
depth$masked_richness <- as.numeric(depth$masked_richness)
depth$mapped_viral_reads <- as.numeric(depth$mapped_viral_reads)
depth$site <- factor(site_of[depth$sample_id], levels = names(rwv_site_colours(style)))
rho <- as.numeric(depth_check$spearman_rho[depth_check$metric == "observed_unrarefied~mapped_viral_reads"])
rwv_check(checks, "Spearman rho shown (3 dp)", 0.857, round(rho, 3), source = "regression constant (dev/390 depth check)")
rwv_check(checks, "depth points", 7, nrow(depth))
# bc1 and bd1 sit close at the top right: nudge bc1 left and bd1 down-right;
# the ρ note sits top left, clear of the bc1 label.
nud <- data.frame(sample_id = c("bc1", "bd1"), nx = c(-0.12, 0.1), ny = c(0, -90))
depth$nx <- ifelse(depth$sample_id %in% nud$sample_id, nud$nx[match(depth$sample_id, nud$sample_id)], 0)
depth$ny <- ifelse(depth$sample_id %in% nud$sample_id, nud$ny[match(depth$sample_id, nud$sample_id)], 0)
p_depth <- ggplot(depth, aes(x = mapped_viral_reads / 1e6, y = masked_richness, colour = site)) +
  geom_point(size = style$point_mm$sample, show.legend = FALSE) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample_id), family = fam, size = rwv_text_pt(style, pt$minimum), seed = 2,
                           show.legend = FALSE, box.padding = 0.4, min.segment.length = 0, nudge_x = depth$nx, nudge_y = depth$ny,
                           segment.size = rwv_linewidth(style$line_mm$hairline), segment.colour = style$colours$grey_ref) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.45, y = 1260, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, family = fam, size = rwv_text_pt(style, pt$minimum), colour = ink,
           label = sprintf("Spearman ρ = %s (n = 7)", rwv_fmt_num(rho, 3))) +   # v45: richness note kept in the legend
  rwv_scale_colour_site(style) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1.5, 2, 3, 5, 10), limits = c(1.4, 13)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1260), breaks = seq(0, 1000, 250), labels = rwv_axis_num) +
  labs(tag = rwv_tag(style, "B"),
       x = "Mapped viral reads (millions, log scale)", y = "Masked richness (vOTUs)") +
  rwv_panel(style) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 1, unit = "mm")))
```

### Task 7: Assemble and export S1

```{r}
#| label: assemble
fig <- (p_len + p_depth + plot_layout(widths = c(1.15, 1))) / free(p_sat) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(50, 92))
expected_text <- c(rwv_tag(style, c("A", "B", "C")), lvl, "Length (kb, log scale)",   # v45: subtitle no longer drawn
                   "Mapped viral reads (millions, log scale)", "Masked richness (vOTUs)", "Complete (n = 167)", "Low-quality (n = 2,254)",
                   "Spearman ρ = 0.857 (n = 7)", unname(layer_lab), "Expected vOTUs", "Expected ASVs",
                   unname(vapply(x_info, function(x) x$lab, "")))
res <- rwv_figure_export(fig, path_target, "sfig1", spec, style, fonts, expected_text, step)
knitr::kable(res$qa[, c("format", "check", "observed", "pass")])
```


### Task 7b: S2: sharing, abundance contributions and 83 co-detected host links

S2 shows shared members, catalogue abundance contributions and 83 best-host-genus links with at least one same-sample co-detection. R/sfig-sharing-hosts.R draws one grid object from formal 020 tables; rwv_figure_export exports four formats. These are counts of saved rows, not an inferred correlation network. Thresholds and models are unchanged; colours are registered under sample_codetection and sharing.

```{r}
#| label: sfig2-sharing-hosts
for (k in c("display_order", "n_qualifying_samples", "n_vOTUs", paste0(lvl, "_percent")))
  sharing_patterns[[k]] <- as.numeric(sharing_patterns[[k]])
for (k in setdiff(names(sharing_samples), "sample_id")) sharing_samples[[k]] <- as.numeric(sharing_samples[[k]])
for (k in setdiff(names(sharing_members), c("vOTU_id", "pattern"))) sharing_members[[k]] <- as.numeric(sharing_members[[k]])
# Sharing checks (unchanged from the former continuation page).
rwv_check(checks2, "sharing sample order is the configured seven-sample order", lvl, sharing_samples$sample_id)
rwv_check(checks2, "sharing member register has every catalogue member once", nrow(catalogue), nrow(sharing_members))
rwv_check(checks2, "sharing register vOTU IDs are unique", 0L, anyDuplicated(sharing_members$vOTU_id))
rwv_check(checks2, "sharing patterns exclude only the all-zero combination", TRUE,
          all(sharing_patterns$pattern != "0000000") && all(grepl("^[01]{7}$", sharing_patterns$pattern)))
rwv_check(checks2, "sharing union plus zero-qualified members equals the catalogue", nrow(catalogue),
          sum(sharing_patterns$n_vOTUs) + sum(sharing_members$n_qualifying_samples == 0))
rwv_check(checks2, "sharing row counts use the member register", TRUE,
          all(vapply(sharing_patterns$pattern, function(x) sum(sharing_members$pattern == x), integer(1)) == sharing_patterns$n_vOTUs))
rwv_check(checks2, "sharing sample totals agree with the S1 depth panel", TRUE,
          all(sharing_samples$qualifying_vOTUs == depth$masked_richness[match(lvl, depth$sample_id)]))
rwv_check(checks2, "sharing abundance categories sum to 100 percent", rep(100, length(lvl)),
          sharing_samples$sample_only_catalogue_percent + sharing_samples$shared_catalogue_percent, tol = 1e-10)
rwv_check(checks2, "every observed combination is drawn (no top-N filter)", 26L, nrow(sharing_patterns),
          source = "020 exact-pattern table (current dataset)")
rwv_check(checks2, "no vOTU qualifies in all seven samples", 0, unique(sharing_samples$all_samples_shared_vOTUs))
pat <- sharing_patterns[order(-sharing_patterns$n_vOTUs, sharing_patterns$pattern), ]
# a inset: members qualifying in >= 2 samples with a retained high-score host record (not a host census of all 296).
shared <- sharing_members$vOTU_id[sharing_members$n_qualifying_samples >= 2]
shh <- hosts[hosts$vOTU_id %in% shared, , drop = FALSE]
phyla <- vapply(strsplit(shh$host_genus_full, ";", fixed = TRUE), function(z) sub("^p__", "", z[startsWith(z, "p__")]), character(1))
hp <- table(phyla); hp <- hp[order(-as.integer(hp), names(hp))]
rwv_check(checks2, "shared members (>= 2 samples) with / without a retained host record", c(296, 18, 278),
          c(length(shared), nrow(shh), length(shared) - nrow(shh)))
rwv_check(checks2, "host phyla of the 18 shared members with a record", c(Bacteroidota = 8, Pseudomonadota = 7, Asgardarchaeota = 2, Bacillota = 1),
          c(hp[["Bacteroidota"]], hp[["Pseudomonadota"]], hp[["Asgardarchaeota"]], hp[["Bacillota"]]))
# c: one row per vOTU whose saved best host genus was co-detected in at least one sample.
rwv_check(checks2, "per-sample co-detection rows: 200 iPHoP records x 7 samples", 1400L,
          sum(codet$endpoint == "iPHoP record (score >= 90)"))
rwv_check(checks2, "every co-detection row belongs to one of the 200 records", TRUE,
          all(codet$vOTU_id[codet$endpoint == "iPHoP record (score >= 90)"] %in% hosts$vOTU_id))
links <- rwv_host_links(hosts, codet, lvl)
n_saved <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(hosts$n_codetected_saved))
rwv_check(checks2, "links equal the records with n_codetected_saved > 0 (020)", sort(hosts$vOTU_id[!is.na(n_saved) & n_saved > 0]), sort(links$vOTU_id))
rwv_check(checks2, "per-link sample counts equal n_codetected_saved", n_saved[match(links$vOTU_id, hosts$vOTU_id)], links$n_codetected_samples)
rwv_check(checks2, "links, genera, sample events", c(83, 43, 86), c(nrow(links), length(unique(links$host_genus)), sum(links$n_codetected_samples)))
rwv_check(checks2, "single-sample and two-sample links", c(80, 3), c(sum(links$n_codetected_samples == 1), sum(links$n_codetected_samples == 2)))
rwv_check(checks2, "every link has a resolved genus and a score >= 90", TRUE, all(nzchar(links$host_genus) & links$host_genus != "NA" & links$iphop_score >= 90))
rwv_check_def(checks2, defs, "iphop_records", nrow(hosts), "host_iphop.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks2, defs, "iphop_codetected", nrow(links), "host_iphop.tsv; host_codetection_by_sample.tsv")
vis <- hosts$visibility_status
host_cls <- c(codetected = nrow(links),
         visible_no_codetection = sum(vis == "named_genus_detected_in_16s") - nrow(links),
         not_detected = sum(vis == "named_genus_not_detected_in_16s"), unresolved = sum(vis == "genus_unresolved"))
rwv_check(checks2, "all 200 records: co-detected / visible only / not detected / unresolved", c(83, 44, 70, 3), unname(host_cls))
lay <- rwv_host_link_layout(links, lvl, unlist(palettes$sample_codetection))
rwv_check(checks2, "S2c footer (legend row + 14 mm) keeps >= 4 mm above the page bottom (v40 layout)", TRUE, lay$legend_y + 14 + 4 <= spec2$height_mm, source = "config/figures.yml")
rwv_check(checks2, "drawn vOTU circles, sample spokes and genus diamonds", c(83, 86, 43),
          c(nrow(lay$nodes), nrow(lay$events), nrow(lay$hosts)))
rwv_check(checks2, "each drawn vOTU is one link (one best genus)", 0L, anyDuplicated(lay$nodes$vOTU_id))
site_for <- setNames(as.character(samples$site), as.character(samples$sample_id))
g2 <- rwv_sharing_hosts_grob(pat, sharing_samples, sharing_members, hosts, links, lay, palettes, style, lvl, site_for, H = spec2$height_mm)
fig2s <- patchwork::wrap_elements(full = g2)
expected2 <- c(rwv_tag(style, c("A", "B", "C")), lvl, "Only this sample", "Also qualifies elsewhere")   # v50: titles, inset and ledgers not drawn
# Genus labels: names with a GTDB placeholder hyphen (display adds U+200C, see R/sfig-sharing-hosts.R) are split
# into two words by PDF text extraction, so they are checked separately below rather than as single tokens.
disp_g <- rwv_taxon_display(unique(links$host_genus))
expected2 <- c(expected2, disp_g[!grepl("\u200c", disp_g)])
res2 <- rwv_figure_export(fig2s, path_target, "sfig2", spec2, style, fonts2, expected2, step)
knitr::kable(res2$qa[, c("format", "check", "observed", "pass")])
zw <- disp_g[grepl("\u200c", disp_g)]
svg_txt <- xml2::xml_text(xml2::xml_find_all(xml2::read_xml(path_target("sfig2.svg")), "//*[local-name()='text']"))
pdf_w <- pdftools::pdf_data(path_target("sfig2.pdf"))[[1]]$text
pdf_pairs <- paste0(head(pdf_w, -1), tail(pdf_w, -1))
rwv_check(checks2, "GTDB placeholder genus labels drawn intact (SVG text node; adjacent PDF words)", c(TRUE, TRUE),
          c(all(zw %in% svg_txt), all(zw %in% pdf_pairs)), source = paste(gsub("\u200c", "", zw), collapse = ", "))
rwv_write_tsv(links, path_target("sfig2-links.tsv"))
```

  "Virome curves are shown for all mapped counts and for the breadth-masked counts used in Fig. 2a; the 75% breadth mask was fixed at full depth and is not re-evaluated on subsampling, so a flat masked curve does not show that viral communities were sampled completely. ",
  "Amplicon curves describe the denoised and filtered ASV tables (16S before rarefaction); microeukaryote reads are drawn from all 18S reads and only non-metazoan ASVs counted. Dashed lines mark the common depths of the alpha diversity analyses. ",

  sprintf("Details: Supplementary figure notes, %s.", spec$label)

  "Panel a: no length threshold beyond the catalogue's own is applied; Undetermined is the CheckV label Not-determined.",

The earlier panel of observed richness as a percentage of Chao1 was withdrawn: its viral values used unmasked counts, and Chao1 is not interpretable for denoised and filtered ASV tables (Deng, Umbach and Neufeld 2024).",
  "Panel c: common depths, virome 1,648,195 breadth-masked reads; 16S 63,564 reads; 18S 53,257 reads of the full 18S table, drawn before Metazoa are removed. The unmasked virome counts have no common depth in this study.",
  "Data 1 S10/S11: PERMANOVA used 999 unrestricted permutations; betadisper requested 9,999 and, with seven samples, enumerated all 5,039 non-identity orderings (5,040 with the observed one), so 0.0002 (1/5,040) is its smallest attainable p. Data 1 S09: Mantel r uses Spearman correlation and 999 permutations; the Procrustes correlation is full-rank (six axes for seven samples), so only its permutation p is informative; the RV coefficient is descriptive, with no permutation test in this study."
)
rwv_write_legend(path_target("sfig1-legend.md"), spec$label, "Catalogue quality and detection diagnostics", legend_en,
